extracted.intended_audience: Heart of Texas Goodwill staff, marketing/communications, designers, and member agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-specific brand guidelines for Heart of Texas Goodwill covering logo usage, color palette, typefaces, mission messaging, signage audits, and marketing/photo release requirements. Intended to direct internal and external marketing collateral to remain on-brand and legally compliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smiling G Trademark — Color Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The preferred version of the trademark is the positive two-color version, which uses PANTONE® Reflex Blue and Black. Four options are available for trademark reproduction purposes: Two-color use: Black with Reflex Blue; One-color use: Black; Alternative one-color use: Reflex Blue; Reverse use: White on solid background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please refer to an official PANTONE Color Formula Guide System for accurate matching. Use the specified color options only for trademark reproduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smiling G Trademark — Spacing & Proportions
rubrics_metrics.description: To give the Smiling G trademark 'room to breathe,' it should appear surrounded by ample space, with the registered trademark symbol falling below the lower right corner. Trademark proportions must remain constant in all reproductions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule of thumb: the spacing all the way around the Smiling G should be equivalent to the size of the black bar at the bottom of the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered Word Marks & Display of ®
rubrics_metrics.description: GOODWILL® and GOODWILL INDUSTRIES® are listed registered word marks. Display the registered trademark symbol ® at least with the first use of a word mark in items such as: Documents, Press materials, Presentations, Marketing collateral, Websites, Emails, Newsletters, Mobile content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure ® appears on first use in the listed materials to protect marks and maintain consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark Ownership & Member Restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Goodwill Industries International (GII) is the owner of Goodwill marks, which are then licensed to members. Goodwill agencies may not officially register for any variation of the Goodwill trademarks, including marks containing 'Goodwill.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members may contact GII to discuss the possibility of registering new marks; do not independently register or alter trademark ownership.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Abuse or Modification of Goodwill Logos
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not abuse or modify any Goodwill logo. This includes but is not limited to skewing the size of the logo, modifying to remove or add additional design elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always use approved artwork/files. Avoid altering proportions, colors, composition, or adding/removing elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heart of Texas Goodwill Logo — Structure & Intended Use
rubrics_metrics.description: The Heart of Texas Goodwill logo incorporates the full legal business name centered between the trademarked Goodwill Smiling G logo and a Texas icon with a small heart positioned to represent the area in Texas which the organization serves. This logo is used in specific applications related directly to branding for Heart of Texas Goodwill Industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this HOTGW-specific logo only for applications directly related to Heart of Texas Goodwill branding; do not substitute or alter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heart of Texas Goodwill Logo — Color Versions & Exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: The preferred version of the trademark is the full color version, which uses Blue (Hex: 001489), Black, Red (Hex: BF2026) and White. Two options are available for trademark reproduction purposes: Full Color w/ Black Text; Full Color w/ White Text. The Heart of Texas Goodwill logo accompanied by the 65th Anniversary logo is used for Email Signature Lines for all employees. The Heart of Texas Goodwill logo accompanied by the tagline, 'Serving the community since 1955' is used for HOTGW letterhead only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate version for the specified application (email signature, letterhead). Do not mix versions outside these uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using the Logo on Colored Backgrounds — File Type
rubrics_metrics.description: When using the Heart of Texas Goodwill Logo on a colored background, use the .PNG file that has a transparent background versus a .JPG file that has a white background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the correct file type (PNG) to avoid white boxes and ensure clean integration on colored backgrounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: People‑First Language for Mission Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: People-first language recognizes that an individual is not defined by his or her challenges, and it puts the individual before the challenge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use recommended phrasings: e.g. 'People with disabilities' or 'Person with an intellectual disability'; 'Youth at risk for delinquency' or 'Young person who is out of school and out of work'; 'Person who was laid off' or 'Experienced workers seeking next careers'; 'Person with a criminal background' etc. Avoid labels that define people by conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission Messaging — Consistency & Themes
rubrics_metrics.description: We strengthen our Goodwill brand by using common themes when communicating about our mission and the individuals served.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When creating mission-related communications, align language, imagery, and tone with the mission statement 'to facilitate change through skills training and work opportunities' and the organization's vision and values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission Program Logos — Apply All Logo Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: All guidelines outlined for use all of Goodwill logos apply to the use of Mission Program logos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-specific logos (e.g., Accelerate, CPT, Operation Good Jobs, Rise, VAT, WAT, Business Services) must follow the same color, spacing, and approval rules as main logos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Logo Usage Restrictions (Internal-only logos)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of this logo or any other marketing communications related to this program should be for internal use only. (example: 'You Matter - Employee Appreciation Program')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use internally-restricted program logos in external-facing marketing or public materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color Palette — Pantone / RGB / CMYK / Hex Specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Color Palette for Supporting Graphics & Logos lists Pantone, RGB, CMYK, and Hex values for brand colors (e.g., Pantone: Reflex Blue — RGB: 0 20 137 — CMYK: 100 96 13 10 — Hex: 001489; Pantone 2143 C — Hex: 3D87CB; Pantone 543 C — Hex: 203864; Pantone 2350 C — Hex: BF2026; Pantone 7548 C — Hex: FEC010; Pantone 2259 C — Hex: 00710E).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please note that RGB & Hex/HTML values will differ between the PANTONE Color Finder and the PANTONE Color Bridge Guides due to different standards for print and digital use. For accurate physical reproduction, refer to official PANTONE Color Formula Guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typefaces for Print — Defaults and Recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: The default font used for most branding applications will be in the Helvetica Font Family. If the user does not own the Helvetica font family, Arial is a suitable substitute. Recommended font types include: GII/Goodwill Logotype: Helvetica Neue; Body Copy: Helvetica Neue Heavy Extended; Heart of Texas Goodwill Logotype: Franklin Gothic Demi; Retail Signage: Playball, Helvetica Bold; Quotations: Times Roman, Arial, Garamond; and others listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the recommended fonts for the specified application; substitute Arial only if Helvetica is unavailable; other substitutions require Marketing approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font Selection Approval Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: An alternative font can be substituted if approved by the Marketing Department. When selecting an alternative font, ask the following questions: Is it legible? Does it communicate with your audience? Does it contribute to the overall look and feel of Goodwill?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit alternative font choices to Marketing for approval; ensure they meet the three criteria above before use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retail Signage Audit — Brand & Condition Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: HOTGW Retail Signage Audit: a store-level audit/checklist to assess retail signage for brand compliance (placement, posting, condition), presence/visibility of Goodwill branding, signage damage, and other compliance items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the audit form to inspect each store's signage; check for damaged or missing signs, proper branding, legibility, correct logos and registered marks, and take corrective actions (repair/replace/submit to Marketing) as indicated by the checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Provided Asset Files (.jpg / .png)
rubrics_metrics.description: Approved asset filenames are provided (e.g., HOTLogo.jpg (white background), HOTLogo.png (transparent background)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the correct asset file based on context (use PNG for transparency, JPG for white-background needs) and never alter the provided files except as permitted by the guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing Photo Release — Permission & Scope of Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Marketing Photo Release: consenting individual (or guardian for minors) grants Heart of Texas Goodwill the right to photograph/video/record and use the individual's likeness, voice, and/or story in promotional materials. Permitted uses include social media, websites, videos, printed materials, and other promotional or distribution purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain signed release prior to using an individual's images or recordings. The release details the scope of use (media types listed), editing rights, and that materials may be used for promotional purposes by Goodwill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing Photo Release — Legal Considerations (minors, compensation, duration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo release language addresses individual/guardian consent, typical statements about use without compensation, and inclusion of minors requiring guardian signature. The form identifies intended uses and that materials may be distributed, published, or used across media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure minor releases are signed by a parent/guardian. Follow the exact legal language on the form regarding compensation, ownership, and duration; retain the signed form in records before publishing any media.
